title: X-Planner: Event-Structured Task Planning for Embodied Intelligence
abstract: arXiv:2609.25187v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Task planning bridges high-level instructions and executable behavior in long-horizon manipulation, yet modern Vision-Language-Action (VLA) systems often leave this intermediate structure implicit. Existing chain-of-thought (CoT) planners also tend to rely on coarse task-level annotations or serialize long reasoning traces token by token. We present X-Planner, a planning front-end that addresses both the supervision and representation of embodied reasoning. Our planning data combine Ego, UMI, and teleoperation under a hierarchy granularity with source-dependent annotation depth. Takeover-time annotations and human-designed failures supervise ongoing error recognition. On the model side, a shared VLM backbone exposes two event-structured plan forms: a discrete interface that emits interpretable event states and a latent interface that relays continuous CoT states across staggered Transformer depths through Staircase Decoding. translated_title: X-Planner：面向具身智能的事件结构化任务规划
translated_abstract: 任务规划在长时程操作中连接高层指令与可执行行为，然而现代视觉-语言-动作（VLA）系统往往使这一中间结构保持隐式。现有的思维链规划器也倾向于依赖粗粒度的任务级标注，或将长推理轨迹逐token地串行化。我们提出X-Planner，一个同时解决具身推理的监督与表示问题的规划前端。我们的规划数据在层次化粒度下融合了Ego（第一人称）、UMI与遥操作数据，并采用随数据来源而定的标注深度。接管时刻标注与人为设计的失败场景用于监督进行中的错误识别。在模型侧，一个共享的VLM主干提供两种事件结构化的规划形式：一个输出可解释事件状态的离散接口，以及一个通过阶梯式解码在交错的Transformer深度间传递连续CoT状态的潜在接口。一个冻结的……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: X-Planner提出了一种事件结构化的具身智能规划前端，通过多源数据的层次化标注与接管时刻失败监督来训练持续错误识别，并在共享VLM主干上同时提供可解释的离散事件状态接口和基于阶梯式解码的连续潜在CoT接口。
en_tdlr: X-Planner is an event-structured planning front-end for embodied intelligence that supervises ongoing error recognition via hierarchical multi-source annotations and takeover-time failure labeling, and exposes both a discrete interpretable event-state interface and a latent continuous CoT interface through Staircase Decoding on a shared VLM backbone.
